articles.summary: BEIJING, Feb. 23, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Kaixin Holdings (“Kaixin” or the “Company”) (NASDAQ: KXIN) today announced that all resolutions presented to the shareholders at its annual general meeting held on February 21, 2026 (the “Annual General Meeting”) were duly passed.
articles.title: Kaixin Holdings Announces 2026 Annual General Meeting Results
